items.question: How do I get to Materm?

content.text: Materm is inside Phou Khao Khouay National Park in Vientiane Province. Send us a message and we'll share directions and help you plan the journey.

items.question: What are the check-in and opening times?

content.text: We are open every day from 08:00 to 18:00. Check-in and check-out times depend on your stay, so we'll confirm them when you book.

items.question: Do you host music nights and events?

content.text: Yes, we hold music evenings and small gatherings from time to time. Ask us about upcoming dates before you plan your visit.

items.question: Can you arrange for groups or special requests?

content.text: We're happy to help with groups, celebrations and special requirements. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll see how we can make it work.
